charm.how: Catch all 400 Pokémon in the Alola Pokédex (Mythicals not needed), then talk to the Game Freak director at the hotel in Heahea City.

methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 4,096 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: One try at the base odds per Pokémon, 3 with the Shiny Charm.

methods.name: Masuda Method
methods.plain: Breed two Pokémon whose games are in different languages: the eggs have a much better shiny chance.
methods.detail: 6 tries per egg, 8 with the Shiny Charm.

methods.name: Breeding (same-language parents)
methods.plain: Ordinary eggs have the normal shiny chance; the Shiny Charm helps them too.

methods.name: SOS chaining
methods.plain: Keep a wild Pokémon calling for help: after 30 calls in a row, each new ally is about 1 in 315 to be shiny (1 in 273 with the Shiny Charm).
methods.detail: +4 tries from a chain of 11, +8 from 21, +12 from 31.

methods.name: Ultra Wormholes
methods.plain: Fly far into an Ultra Wormhole: past 5,000 light-years, the Pokémon at the end can be up to 36% shiny, depending on the kind of wormhole.
methods.detail: Shiny chance by wormhole type: 1%, (1 + n)%, (1 + 2n)%, 4n%, where n = min(9, light-years ÷ 500 − 1); the steps are at 5,000+ light-years. Regular Pokémon only; legendaries and Ultra Beasts in Ultra Space use the normal odds, and there the Shiny Charm counts. The Shiny Charm doesn't help these.
methods.note: Serebii's Ultra Wormhole formula; no datamine found, so the steps are rounded
